chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: San Jose, 2024. Kansas City against Bay FC. Temwa Chawinga needs one more goal for the record. She steals the ball, rides the tackle, races on... and shoots from outside the box. What a rocket!

chapters.label: Goal-side
chapters.text: Watch again. She sprints in and nicks the ball away. The midfielder pushes, but Chawinga stays strong. Now she is goal-side.

chapters.label: Pick your corner
chapters.text: From outside the box, she picks her corner and strikes. It rockets into the net: goal nineteen, a new NWSL record!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: use your speed to get goal-side, then pick your corner.
